customManagers.description: Tool versions in the extras-build matrix, read from the `# renovate:` comment above each entry. Every other version-dependent field uses {version}, so only `version:` changes.

packageRules.description: One PR for all minor/patch updates. Renovate merges one branch per run and every merge rebases and rebuilds the rest, so separate PRs take one run each. Listed first so the GitHub Actions group below still wins for actions.
Major updates (runner images, action majors) get a PR, but a human merges them.
Fedora major bumps are done by hand, together with Containerfile.bootc and the bootc-build matrix.
Never automerge the bootc base image. Not tracked today (Containerfile.bootc builds its tag from ARGs); this guards a future change.
